Rejuran® is a skin healing treatment developed by Korean scientists that has shown impressive results. The key ingredient is c-PDRN® – fragmented DNA derived from Salmon DNA, and it encourages dramatic age-defying results for more radiant, youthful looking skin.

It has gained much popularity in Korea, Japan, Taiwan and Singapore. While the Rejuran® treatments were originally available only as injections, we have developed the needle-less treatment to give you great results without the downtime and discomfort.

This treatment focuses on depositing c-PDRN® and a blend of powerful antioxidants into your skin cells, where it activates natural healing and collagen growth, both which are essential for healthy glowing skin. c-PDRN® is a patented next-generation ingredient, technically known as Hydrolyzed DNA (extracted from Salmon DNA as it is most compatible with human DNA), the building blocks of life. This key ingredient is scientifically proven to have unique skin healing properties when applied to human skin. It was first used in hospitals to help burn victims recuperate their skin, and since then has been developed for aesthetics purposes.

Why our skin needs help to renew

As we age, our skin produces less collagen and cell renewal cycle slows from 28 days to as many as 50 days, resulting in dull, sagging, damaged skin. c-PDRN® contains naturally occurring growth factors that stimulates cell renewal, this helps promote skin rejuvenation and improves the appearance of damaged skin, restoring the look of skin’s elasticity, firmness and radiance.

Infinity Needle-less Rejuran® helps by:
  • Improve cell renewal cycle for healthier cells to surface
  • Restore collagen structure
  • Powerful antioxidants are also applied to skin to protect skin and improve brilliance
  • Active ingredients are deposited deep into skin cells without the use of needles

c-PDRN® molecules are 670 times smaller than human skin pores. This low molecular weight allows it to be more easily absorbed through topical skincare products for fast, effective results. Unlike ingredients with a high molecular weight that are poorly absorbed and sit on top of your skin, c-PDRN’s tiny molecules are readily absorbed for maximum benefit. This makes it a good candidate for needle-less infusion, where it can enter your skin at the cellular level to bring about natural healing and rejuvenation.

c-PDRN® contains naturally occurring growth factor cell stimulators. It helps improve skin in the following ways:

  • Improves firmness, reduces sagging and increases elasticity.
  • Improves the hydration of skin, addressing dull, flaky skin associated with aging.
  • Delivers a brighter looking complexion and smoother skin.
  • Improves the look of fine lines & wrinkles.
  • Improves the appearance of skin tone and texture
  • Improves the appearance of dark spots, skin blemishes, and facial scars

This treatment is a needleless option of the popular medical injection procedure known as Rejuran® Healer, Baby Skin Injection or 婴儿针. Infinity Needleless Rejuran® was created to administer Rejuran® deep into the skin layers effectively without injections.

We use Electroporation to deliver Rejuran® c-PDRN deep into the skin layers, penetrating the superficial layers without the need for any invasive needles. Electroporation’s electrical pulses increases the skin cell’s absorption ability which then allows infusion of Rejuran® into deeper skin layers without any injection. During this process, the cell walls become temporarily more permeable, thus improving absorption. This allows the active ingredients to improve underlying conditions, bringing about healing and regeneration from within.

Rejuran® awakens the skin’s self-healing to restore its own collagen structure. The clinical procedure involves about 200 injection points on the face. However, for those that prefer a less invasive and less painful method, this needleless version is a great option.

The Rejuran® Tone Up Booster is a cocktail consisting c-PDRN plus 5 other main active ingredients that work simultaneously to improve skin health, strengthen skin’s natural barrier and improve appearance, with visible results like radiance, reduced scaring, smaller pores and better skin tone and contours.

Who is suitable for Needleless Rejuran® Treatment?

This treatment is highly recommended for those with:

  • Pigmentation (age spots, sun spots) and wants to lighten them
  • Acne / scarring
  • Sagging / ageing skin
  • Large pores and wants to brighten and improve skin texture
  • Those who are afraid of needles
Is there any downtime for the treatment?

This treatment is 100% comfortable, non-invasive with no downtime. Our Electroporation technology does not use a single needle for this treatment, and hence, there will be no skin breakage at all.

Is this treatment painful?

This treatment is not painful and numbing cream is not required.
